categories.name: Walking & Turning
categories.definition: Walking forward, backward, or sideways, or making a walking or in-place turn.

categories.name: Running & Agility
categories.definition: Jogging, running, sprinting, or taking quick lateral steps, cuts, and dodges.

categories.name: Jumping & Landing
categories.definition: Jumping, hopping, leaping, or landing after takeoff.

categories.name: Balance & Recovery
categories.definition: Balancing, correcting a stumble or slip, falling, or recovering from a loss of balance.

categories.name: Stairs & Climbing
categories.definition: Going up or down stairs, stepping onto a raised surface, climbing, or hanging.

categories.name: Posture Changes
categories.definition: Sitting, standing up, kneeling, lying down, or moving between the floor and standing.

categories.name: Reaching & Handling
categories.definition: Reaching for, lifting, carrying, placing, grasping, pushing, or pulling. Use tags for a box or another object when the source identifies it.

categories.name: Everyday Tasks
categories.definition: Acting out a recognizable routine such as dressing, washing, grooming, or cleaning.

categories.name: Gestures & Pantomime
categories.definition: Waving, pointing, shrugging, signaling, or acting something out through body movement.

categories.name: Dance
categories.definition: Performing dance steps, turns, or choreographed phrases.

categories.name: Sports
categories.definition: Performing sport-specific actions such as a golf swing, basketball shot, or swim stroke.

categories.name: Acrobatics
categories.definition: Performing cartwheels, handstands, flips, rolls, or similarly gymnastic movements.

categories.name: Exercise & Mobility
categories.definition: Stretching, practicing yoga, or performing a drill or repeated range-of-motion exercise.

categories.name: Action Sequences
categories.definition: Performing several equally important actions with no single dominant movement.

categories.name: Poses & Reference
categories.definition: Holding a pose or performing a technical calibration or reference take.
